body: One memdb 'promise' record per forward-looking statement from concalls, presentations, AR MD&A and press releases. Fields (in data): source_doc, source_url, speaker, verbatim quote, category (revenue_growth, margin, capex, capacity_commissioning, order_inflow, order_book, debt_reduction, working_capital, new_product, regulatory_approval, customer_win, m&a, payout), metric, baseline, target_low/high, unit, deadline plus deadline_precision, specificity 0-3, unprompted (yes/no), conditionality, status (open, delivered, partially_delivered, missed, moved_goalpost, withdrawn, superseded), status_history with evidence, check_after, delivery_ratio. Also extract each quarter's explanations for misses (to test 'one-off' claims) and KPIs or topics that stopped being mentioned. Scoring: delivered +1, partial +0.5, missed -1, moved goalpost or silent drop -1.5, candid withdrawal -0.5. Weights are specificity x materiality x recency (8-quarter half-life). Management Credibility Score is the weighted mean over 12 quarters, reported with hit rate, average delivery ratio, average delay, number of moved goalposts, and a candour index (share of misses acknowledged unprompted). Compare the score with tone: high tone and low score is an avoid or short-side flag; low-key tone and high score points to an under-recognised compounder. Example: KPIT Q2FY27 call (28-Oct-2026), CEO on EBITDA margin returning to about 20-21%: 'it will go up to some extent, every quarter... early next year'. Target 20-21%, deadline about Mar-2027, specificity 2.
title: Promise tracker: schema and scoring for management promise-vs-delivery
